name: @qu/space-components
description: Qu V5: the declarative reactive Component layer over @qu/space-ui's imperative bind()/bindList() primitives - <qu-view>/<qu-bind>/<qu-list>, Custom Elements a CMS-authored template can write directly as markup to live-bind Space data, no JS glue code required (architecture.md's corrected "Phase 2" - a visitor's own data is an ORDINARY binding, not a special case; this package is what was actually missing). index.js (this package's main entry) is plain-Node-importable (context.js/resolve.js's ancestor-DOM-resolution helpers only, no HTMLElement); the Custom Elements themselves live behind the separate "./elements" entry (src/elements.js) since `class extends HTMLElement` throws under plain Node with no DOM/jsdom shim - see @qu/app-shell's shell.js for the identical, already-established split.
